cases.description: SWFL Eagle Cam #3, 1.5 h clip from 18,000 s holding the two search events (detect ranks 5 and 13 at 20,247 and 20,585 s; windows 20,117-20,697 s, so 2,117 s and 2,703 s of margin)

source.acquisition: yt-dlp download of the archived live stream's Opus track (format 251), see raw/audio/youtube/swfl_2024-12-28.ytdlp.log and .info.json; local only

start_time.source: YouTube info.json release_timestamp (1735395676, whole seconds): the live broadcast's start. How the archived VOD's first sample relates to it is undocumented, so the uncertainty is a judgement, not a measurement. The clip starts 18,000 s later

reference_clock_utc.basis: derived from the development search on the full recording: t_heard1 of the committed top candidate (a2baea at 1735415920.772) minus event 1's heard CPA (20,247.487 s) minus its shift (0.0 s), plus the 18,000 s clip offset. Depends on the matched flights; not an independent source

derived.note: sample-exact cut of the decoded 48 kHz stereo stream (atrim counts samples after decoding, so the offset holds exactly), written as 16-bit WAV
spectrogram of the clip with the CLI defaults; its whitening sees only the clip, so it differs from the full recording's near the clip edges
